final_message: Rewrote pm-change-request-log-sample to the rulebook structure, addressing grade findings F001-F019 and F021-F024. F020 (generated-view template nature) was left as a rulebook/template follow-up. Prettier passed.
handoff: F020 not applied: the template `pm-change-request-log-template` assumes the register-generated view (`rulebook: specdojo:pjr-rulebook`), while the rulebook forbids editing generated files and defines the standalone `CR-NNN` log. The sample keeps the standalone form. Proposed rulebook/template change: state which form the sample illustrates, and consider adding a standalone-log template.
Proposed rulebook change: in the 影響評価 guide, require stating the 影響度 scale (e.g., `小`/`中`/`大` with criteria) so evaluations are reproducible (grade F015/F022).
Undecided value left as `_UNDECIDED_`: whether CR effort is within the per-participant work-time cap depends on U-02 in the pm-plan sample; the user must decide U-02.

CR-002 (CSV column order for accounting software) was replaced with a daily-sales subtotal row because the original conflicted with the scope sample's out-of-scope 本格的な会計連携. The rulebook's good examples still mention 会計ソフト; consider aligning them with the common sample context.
